title: Nerja and Frigiliana with Mario
text: Nerja and Frigiliana are two places you should visit while vacationing in Granada. I can’t think of anyone better than Mario to do that with. He picked us up right on time, showed us a great time and had great recommendations for us. This tour offers you plenty of time to enjoy the two towns.
author: NoelOrozco

title: Wonderful day trip to Caves of Nerja and Frigiliana white village
text: Great experience on a full-day tour of the Caves of Nerja, white village of Fragiliana, and Balcony of Europe on the Costa del Sol.   Our tour guide (and driver), Predrag, was fabulous, and it was a pleasure to spend the day guided by him.  First stop was the pre-historic Caves at Nerja with giant stalactites and stalagmites and other amazing sights.  Next was Frigiliana, probably the most beautiful white village in Spain. author: linda7114

title: Wonderful day trip to caves and southern coast
text: We had a delightful tour guide Jianna who tailored the trip exactly to our preferences. She took us to so many beautiful sites and photo opportunities. We told her that we were interested in spending time at the beach, and she guided us to a magnificent beach location where we got to spend two hours, enjoying the sun and surf.  The Njera caves were breathtaking, and the town of Frigliana is idyllic. This tour is a very nice way to experience the southern coast in all its charm and beauty.
author: B3226DMtylers

title: Life is an adventure
text: Everything with the trip was amazing. Our group was small and we were not rushed which is very important to me because I traveled with three kids who are all under 10 years old.   I will definitely do it again when we comeback to Spain.
author: Fatuma_P

title: All day fun trip to caves and coast! Highly recommended!!
text: We had an absolutely fantastic time with Theresa, our tour guide / driver. She showed us everything we wanted to see and was extremely friendly, warm and gracious. We were lucky to have a private tour with her, and by the end, felt like we were saying farewell to a long time friend.
author: elizabeth_s

title: Great guide and tour!
text: Our day with Jose Manuel was fantastic! He was so much fun and so enthusiastic. We learned so much about the production of olive oil, and he even took us to his farm where he produces his own. We then went to Nerja for lunch and visit to the “ balcony of Europe”. One of the best trips ever!
author: Sandra_S
